main.name: Ingþór Birkir Árnason
main.bio: I’m a Senior Software Engineer based in Reykjavík, Iceland, specializing in full-stack web development, CI/CD, and DevOps. At NOVA Iceland, I build customer-facing telecom solutions, including mobile eSIM signup and travel connectivity. Previously, I worked on self-service data platforms at Swisscom, where I also served as my team’s Security Champion. Outside work, I build products that bring people together and make learning more hands-on: DeckMate, PadelHub, and ChessAITutor. I enjoy football, outdoor activities, and taking on new challenges.
main.description: Senior Software Engineer at NOVA Iceland. Building web products, telecom services, and ideas of my own.

education.description: Focused on web development and user interface design, with experience working independently and in teams.
AWS Cloud concepts, AWS services, security, architecture and pricing.

work.title: Senior Software Engineer
work.description: Developed a mobile eSIM self-service signup flow and contributed to the Travel eSIM solution, helping customers get connected in just four clicks. Improve backend reliability and scalability across customer-facing telecom platforms.

work.title: Senior Software Engineer for Data, Analytics & AI
work.description: Continued work on internal self-service data platforms, data management, and secure software delivery, helping teams discover and use data across Swisscom.

work.title: Software Engineer for Data, Analytics & AI
work.description: Built and maintained full-stack self-service data applications and CI/CD pipelines. Helped introduce metadata and data-lineage tooling so teams could understand downstream dependencies. As Security Champion, maintained security documentation and automated code and dependency checks. Supported the team’s AWS cloud journey.

work.title: Software Engineer
work.description: Worked as a consultant for the Swiss government’s Federal Office of Information Technology, Systems and Telecommunication. Built tax-authority web applications with Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and Kafka, with unit, integration, and Selenium regression tests. Maintained Jenkins pipelines and Cloud Foundry deployments.

work.title: Software Developer / Software Engineer
work.description: Worked with Risk Management Solutions and teams in London and New York. Built C# and .NET integrations, SQL-backed APIs, and Azure delivery pipelines. Developed Django applications and Python data pipelines using AWS Lambda, S3, and API Gateway, alongside React frontend features.

work.title: Software Developer
work.description: Built frontend features with React and Redux at an early-stage travel startup. Contributed product ideas, worked with AWS and Git, and improved search-engine visibility.

work.title: Web Developer · Part-time
work.description: Worked as a full-stack developer while studying, using Java, JavaScript, and MySQL. Created website themes and games, and set up TeamCity continuous integration and deployment for the company’s Git branches.

portfolio.intro: From shared adventures and padel nights to learning chess: products I build around the things I enjoy.

projects.title: DeckMate
projects.category: Turn your trip crew into a deck of trading cards. Create invite-only trips, give friends cards with photos and playful stats, and draw a person or challenge whenever the group needs a spark. Keep the stories and photos together in private trip moments.
highlights: Invite-only trips and shared person cards
Random draws, custom challenges, and private moments
React web client plus native mobile apps

projects.title: PadelHub
projects.category: A home for padel players in Iceland to organize games, record scores, and compete with friends. Run Americano and Mexicano tournaments with automatic pairings, rounds, and standings, or create private groups for recurring sessions and season competition. Available in Icelandic and English.
highlights: Tournament formats with automatic pairings and scoring
Private groups, invite links, and recurring sessions

projects.title: ChessAITutor
projects.category: Learn chess by playing. Challenge AI opponents at Amateur, Intermediate, and Experienced levels, then explore interactive lessons on moves, tactics, openings, and endgames. Chess puzzles and practical guidance make it easy to move from reading about a concept to trying it on the board.
highlights: Browser-based play on desktop and mobile

projects.title: Bilabud.is
projects.category: An Icelandic online store for remote-controlled cars and construction vehicles. Shoppers can browse off-road vehicles, drift cars, and model machinery, explore special offers, and check prices and stock availability before adding products to their basket.
highlights: Prices, special offers, and stock availability
Shopping basket and individual product pages

projects.title: Gluggasalan.is
projects.category: Created a website for a window supplier in Selfoss, Iceland. The site presents window and sliding-door ranges, installation services, and showroom contact information to help customers explore their options.

projects.title: Travelade
projects.category: A travel discovery platform built around local recommendations. As an early frontend developer, I contributed React and Redux features, product ideas, and SEO improvements.
